_meta.what: Presentation DEFAULTS (colour group + icon, and the groups' colours) per element type. Defaults, not authority — tools may override, and Atlas remaps wholesale for dark mode.
_meta.public: Per type, the fields the OnlyWorlds platform shows on a 'known of' element (one a reader knows of but does not see whole) beside its name, description, supertype, subtype and picture. Platform behaviour, not a default to override; an empty list means those base fields only.
_meta.provenance: Four-colour palette adopted 2026-07 for measured colour-vision-deficiency separation: the previous 22-hue set left Title and Trait at deltaE 1.3 for deutan viewers. Values validated; change one only after re-running a colour-vision check, not by taste.
_meta.groups: A visual aid for drawing the 22 types; not part of the standard. A reader that meets a word not in colors.order fails loudly, naming the word; it never draws a default colour.

colors._note: Defaults. Tools MAY override. Light assumes near-white surfaces, dark assumes near-black (measured against #0a0a0a). The green is identical in both modes and sits at its low-contrast end deliberately. Colour carries the GROUP; the icon carries the TYPE — dark-mode pairs land in the 6-8 deltaE floor band, so icon + label are REQUIRED alongside colour, never optional.
